hotelDesc.overview:
Experience Luxury and Elegance at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake

Indulge in a world of opulence and sophistication at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake, a luxurious 5-star hotel located in the heart of Hanoi, Vietnam. With its impeccable service, stunning architecture, and lavish amenities, this hotel is the perfect choice for discerning travelers seeking a truly memorable stay. Step into a realm of pure indulgence as you enter the hotel's grand lobby, adorned with exquisite marble and gold accents. The attention to detail and the tasteful blend of modern design and Vietnamese cultural influences create an ambiance of elegance and refinement. With 342 beautifully appointed rooms, Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake offers a variety of accommodation options to suit every guest's needs. Each room is meticulously designed to provide the utmost comfort and luxury, featuring contemporary furnishings, state-of-the-art technology, and breathtaking views of the city skyline or the serene lake nearby. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, you'll find everything you need for a truly unforgettable stay.

Unforgettable Nights at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake

Experience the vibrant nightlife at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake, where entertainment facilities are designed to create unforgettable nights. The hotel boasts a stylish bar, perfect for enjoying a refreshing cocktail or a glass of wine while taking in the stunning views of the city. Whether you're looking for a lively atmosphere or a more relaxed evening, the bar at Dolce has something to suit every mood. For those seeking a night filled with music and dancing, the hotel features a vibrant nightclub where you can dance the night away to the latest beats. With a state-of-the-art sound system and a spacious dance floor, the nightclub offers an electrifying ambiance that will keep you on your feet until the early hours. If you prefer a more laid-back evening, the shared lounge/TV area is the perfect place to unwind. Sink into comfortable sofas and catch up on your favorite TV shows or engage in a friendly conversation with fellow guests. The lounge area provides a cozy and inviting atmosphere, making it an ideal spot to relax and socialize after a long day of exploring the city. At Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake, your nights are destined to be filled with excitement, laughter, and unforgettable memories.

Unparalleled Sports Facilities at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake

Indulge in a world of fitness and leisure at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake, where an array of exceptional sports facilities awaits. Stay in shape and elevate your workout routine at the state-of-the-art fitness center, equipped with modern exercise machines and free weights. Whether you prefer cardio exercises or strength training, our 24-hour fitness center caters to all your fitness needs, ensuring you can maintain your fitness regimen at any time that suits you best. Take a refreshing dip in our outdoor pool, surrounded by lush greenery and offering a tranquil oasis in the heart of the city. After an invigorating swim, head to the poolside bar to enjoy a refreshing beverage or a light snack, while soaking up the sun and enjoying the picturesque views. Our outdoor pool provides the perfect setting to relax and unwind, whether you're on a leisurely vacation or looking for a quick escape from the bustling city. With our complimentary access to the fitness center and the convenience of a 24-hour facility, Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake ensures that your fitness goals are within reach throughout your stay. Dive into the pool and savor the delightful offerings at the poolside bar, creating unforgettable memories of relaxation and rejuvenation during your stay in Hanoi, Vietnam.

Unparalleled Convenience at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake

At Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake, we prioritize your comfort and convenience. Our hotel offers a wide range of convenience facilities to ensure that your stay with us is nothing short of exceptional. With 24-hour room service, you can indulge in delicious meals and snacks at any time of the day, right in the comfort of your own room. We understand that laundry can be a hassle while traveling, which is why we provide a laundry service and a laundromat for your convenience. Our dedicated staff will take care of all your laundry needs, allowing you to focus on enjoying your stay. Additionally, our dry cleaning service ensures that your clothes always look their best. For added peace of mind, we offer safety deposit boxes to keep your valuables secure. Our concierge is always ready to assist you with any requests or recommendations, ensuring that you have a seamless stay. Stay connected with our complimentary Wi-Fi, available in all rooms and public areas. We also offer express check-in/check-out services and luggage storage, allowing you to make the most of your time in Hanoi. Our dedicated housekeeping team ensures that your room is clean and comfortable throughout your stay. Finally, relax and unwind by the fireplace, creating a cozy ambiance during your stay at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake.

Convenient Transport Facilities at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake

At Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake, guests can enjoy a range of convenient transport facilities to make their stay hassle-free. The hotel offers airport transfer services, ensuring a smooth and comfortable journey to and from the airport. For those looking to explore the city, the hotel provides tour assistance, making it easy for guests to discover the best attractions and hidden gems of Hanoi. Valet parking and a car park are available on-site, providing secure and convenient parking options for guests with their own vehicles. Additionally, the hotel offers a shuttle service and car hire for those who prefer to leave the driving to someone else. For quick and easy transportation, guests can also make use of the taxi service available at the hotel. To further enhance the guest experience, Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake offers a ticket service, allowing guests to easily book tickets for local attractions and events. Whether guests choose to explore the city by car or on foot, the hotel's self-parking and free car park facilities ensure that parking is never a concern. With these comprehensive transport facilities, guests can enjoy a seamless and convenient stay at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake.

Luxurious Room Facilities at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake

Indulge in opulence and comfort with the exquisite room facilities offered at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake. Each room is designed to provide a lavish and memorable stay for guests. One of the standout features is the presence of a cozy fireplace, perfect for creating a warm and inviting ambiance. Whether you're visiting during the chilly winter months or simply want to add a touch of romance to your stay, the fireplace offers a delightful addition to your room experience. Curl up with a good book or enjoy a glass of wine by the crackling fire, creating cherished moments during your stay at this luxurious hotel.

Indulge in Culinary Delights at Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake

At Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake, guests are treated to a range of exceptional dining facilities that cater to every palate and preference. Whether you're craving a delicious meal in the comfort of your room or looking to enjoy a delightful dining experience at the hotel's restaurant, you'll find it all here. Start your day off right with a scrumptious breakfast buffet, offering a wide selection of both local and international dishes. From freshly baked pastries to made-to-order omelets, there's something to satisfy every craving. For those seeking a quick pick-me-up or a leisurely coffee break, the hotel's coffee shop is the perfect spot to relax and enjoy a cup of your favorite brew. If you're in the mood for a more indulgent dining experience, look no further than the hotel's restaurant. With its elegant ambiance and diverse menu, you can savor a range of delectable dishes prepared by talented chefs. From traditional Vietnamese cuisine to international favorites, each dish is crafted with the finest ingredients and presented with impeccable attention to detail. For those who prefer a more casual dining experience, the hotel also offers 24-hour room service, allowing you to enjoy a meal in the privacy and comfort of your own room.
